label: Adaptivity Scaling
description: Allocate reasoning effort dynamically, where and when it is useful.

zh.label: 自适应扩展
zh.description: 根据推理需要动态分配算力。

label: Context Scaling
description: Scale what models can exchange beyond text-only communication.

zh.label: 上下文扩展
zh.description: 让模型交换更丰富的上下文信息，不局限于文本。

label: Model Compression
description: Reduce the cost of tokens and attention without discarding what matters.

zh.label: 模型压缩
zh.description: 保留关键信息，减少 token 和注意力计算的开销。
